author: (Say, 1838)

note.en: A slender, elongate tellin that burrows in muddy sand. The only record is a museum specimen labelled Punta Uva. Size is approximate (no measured value found).
note.es: Una telina alargada y delgada que se entierra en arena fangosa. El único registro es un ejemplar de museo rotulado Punta Uva. El tamaño es aproximado (no se encontró una medida publicada).

evidence: GBIF: 1 preserved specimen labelled Punta Uva (University of Miami RSMAS collection)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection and other museum records), Gandoca to Limón
